sentence_stem: By the time the results arrive,
correct_completion: the team will have finished the experiment.
full_sentence: By the time the results arrive, the team will have finished the experiment.
acceptable_variants: the team will have completed the work.

options.text: the team finishes the experiment yesterday.
options.why_wrong: The present tense 'finishes' does not match 'yesterday', and 'by the time' needs a future perfect to show completion before a future point.

options.text: the team will finish the experiment tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: The future simple gives a plan for a future moment, but it does not show that the action is completed before the results arrive.

options.text: the team had finished the experiment last week.
options.why_wrong: The past perfect refers to a past time, not to a point in the future when the results arrive.

options.text: the team will have finished the experiment.

explanation: With 'by the time', the future perfect shows that an action will already be completed before a future point in time.
translation: بحلول الوقت الذي تصل فيه النتائج، سيكون الفريق قد أنهى التجربة.
